integrity: Symbolic CW quotient proof with independently executable simplicial homology tests over F2 and F3; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty simple triangle-free H and integer s>=2; nonequivariant homotopy only. Prior complete-split-graph cases not claimed as new; unindexed equivalent literature remains a risk. Finite checks support but do not replace proof.
title: A homotopy transfer for triangle-free clique joins
